◈ "UNIT LUCKY COIN — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did.

◈ FLASHBACK — Lucky Coin
Worn smooth. Muhindo flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.

◈ "UNIT TRAIL COMPASS — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; harder to get truly lost. You knew it mat

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ "UNIT FIELD SUTURE KIT — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; usable: +15 health. You knew it matter

◈ FLASHBACK — Field suture kit
You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since.

◈ "UNIT DEAD PHONE — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dead Phone
Cracked screen, 2% forever. The last text, unsent: 'call when you can.' It was from Prince — your brother. You have carried the unsent message for years. Maybe he is still out
